title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六 孝武帝
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六 孝武帝 Volume 6 Annals 6: Emperor Xiao Wu

sentences.zh: 世祖孝武皇帝諱駿，字休龍，小字道民，文帝第三子也。

translations.literal: The Shizu Emperor Xiao Wu's taboo name was Jun; his style name was Xiulong and his childhood name Daomin. He was the third son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiao Wu, temple name Shizu, was named Jun; his style name was Xiulong and his childhood name Daomin. He was Emperor Wen's third son.

sentences.zh: 元嘉七年秋八月庚午生。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn in the seventh year of Yuanjia, on the day gengwu, he was born.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on gengwu day in the eighth month of autumn in the seventh year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 十二年，立為武陵王，食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, he was installed as Prince of Wuling with a fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Prince of Wuling, with a fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 十六年，都督湘州諸軍事、征虜將軍、湘州刺史，領石頭戍事。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, he was made Supervisor of All Military Affairs in Xiangzhou, General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, and Inspector of Xiangzhou, and took charge of the Stone City garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was appointed to supervise all military affairs in Xiangzhou, as General Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Inspector of Xiangzhou, and took charge of the Stone City garrison.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷使持節、都督南豫豫司雍并五州諸軍事、南豫州刺史，將軍如故，猶戍石頭。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he was transferred to Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Supervisor of All Military Affairs in the five provinces of Southern Yu, Yu, Si, Yong, and Bing, and Inspector of Southern Yu; his generalship remained unchanged, and he still garrisoned Stone City.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority and supervisor of military affairs in Southern Yu, Yu, Si, Yong, and Bing, with the post of Inspector of Southern Yu; he kept his former rank as general and continued to garrison Stone City.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，加督秦州，進號撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he was additionally made supervisor of Qinzhou and promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was given additional supervision of Qinzhou and promoted to General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 明年，徙都督雍梁南北秦四州荊州之襄陽竟陵南陽順陽新野隨六郡諸軍事、[1]寧蠻校尉、雍州刺史，持節、將軍如故。

translations.literal: The next year, he was transferred to supervise all military affairs in the four provinces of Yong, Liang, Northern Qin, and Southern Qin and in the six commanderies of Xiangyang, Jingling, Nanyang, Shunyang, Xinye, and Sui in Jingzhou, as Colonel Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Inspector of Yong; he retained the Staff of Authority and his generalship.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was reassigned to oversee military affairs in Yong, Liang, Northern Qin, and Southern Qin and in six Jingzhou commanderies—Xiangyang, Jingling, Nanyang, Shunyang, Xinye, and Sui—as Colonel Who Pacifies the Barbarians and Inspector of Yong, retaining the Staff of Authority and his rank as general.

sentences.zh: 自晉氏江左以來，襄陽未有皇子重鎮，時太祖欲經略關、河，故有此授。

translations.literal: Since the Jin dynasty established itself south of the Yangzi, no imperial prince had ever held so weighty a post at Xiangyang; at the time the founding emperor wished to advance against the lands west of the Yellow River, and for this reason made the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Jin had moved the court south of the Yangzi, no imperial prince had been stationed in so important a post at Xiangyang; the founding emperor now wished to recover the northwest, and so made this appointment.

sentences.zh: 尋給鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was granted one set of martial music.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon granted a full complement of martial music.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，改授都督南兗徐兗青冀幽六州豫州之梁郡諸軍事、安北將軍、徐州刺史，持節如故，北鎮彭城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, he was reassigned to supervise all military affairs in the six provinces of Southern Yan, Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, and You and in the Liang commandery of Yu, as General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xuzhou; he retained the Staff of Authority and took up his northern post at Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was made supervisor of military affairs in Southern Yan, Xu, Yan, Qing, Ji, You, and the Liang commandery of Yu, as General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xuzhou; he kept the Staff of Authority and moved north to garrison Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 尋領兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he also took charge as Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He soon took on the additional post of Inspector of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 始興王濬為南兗州，上解督南兗。

translations.literal: When Prince Shixing Jun became Inspector of Southern Yan, he relinquished supervision of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Shixing Jun was made Inspector of Southern Yan, he gave up supervision of that province.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，坐汝陽戰敗，降號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because of defeat at Ruyang, his rank was reduced to General Who Guards the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, after the defeat at Ruyang, he was demoted to General Who Guards the Army.

sentences.zh: 又以索虜南侵，降為北中郎將。

translations.literal: Because the northern enemy invaded the south, he was further reduced to General of the North.
translations.idiomatic: When the Rong enemy pushed south, he was demoted again to General of the North.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，進督南兗州、南兗州刺史，當鎮山陽。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, he was advanced to supervise Southern Yan and made Inspector of Southern Yan, with his headquarters at Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was given additional supervision of Southern Yan and made its inspector, with his headquarters at Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 尋遷都督江州荊州之江夏豫州之西陽晉熙新蔡四郡諸軍事、南中郎將、江州刺史，持節如故。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to supervise all military affairs in Jiangzhou, the Jiangxia commandery of Jingzhou, and the four commanderies of Xiyang, Jinxi, Xincai, and Xiyang in Yu, as General of the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou; he retained the Staff of Authority.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon reassigned to oversee military affairs in Jiangzhou, Jiangxia in Jingzhou, and four Yu commanderies—Xiyang, Jinxi, Xincai, and Xiyang—as General of the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, retaining the Staff of Authority.

sentences.zh: 時緣江蠻為寇，太祖遣太子步兵校尉沈慶之等伐之，使上總統眾軍。

translations.literal: At the time the riverine tribes were raiding along the Yangzi; the founding emperor sent the Crown Prince's Colonel of Footsoldiers Shen Qingzhi and others to campaign against them and ordered him to take overall command of the armies.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the river tribes were raiding along the Yangzi; the founding emperor sent the Crown Prince's Colonel of Footsoldiers Shen Qingzhi and others against them and put him in overall command.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月，上出次西陽之五洲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirtieth year, he went out and encamped at Wuzhou in Xiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirtieth year he marched out and encamped at Wuzhou in Xiyang.

sentences.zh: 會元凶弒逆，以上為征南將軍，加散騎常侍。

translations.literal: When the deposed crown prince committed regicide, he was made General Who Pacifies the South and given the additional post of Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince turned regicide, he was made General Who Pacifies the South and Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 上率眾入討，荊州刺史南譙王義宣、雍州刺史臧質並舉義兵。

translations.literal: He led his forces in to suppress the rebellion; the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, and the Inspector of Yongzhou Zang Zhi both raised righteous armies.
translations.idiomatic: He led his troops in to suppress the rebellion; the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, and the Inspector of Yongzhou Zang Zhi both raised armies in the cause.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉，上次溧洲。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the fourth month, he reached Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the fourth month he reached Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，冠軍將軍柳元景前鋒至新亭，修建營壘。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the vanguard of the Champion General Liu Yuanda reached Xinting and built fortified camps.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the vanguard under Champion General Liu Yuanda reached Xinting and built fortified camps.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賊劭親率眾攻元景，大敗退走。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the rebel Shao personally led his forces to attack Yuanda and was utterly defeated and driven back.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the rebel Shao led his army against Yuanda in person and was routed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上次江寧。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, he advanced to Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he advanced to Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大將軍江夏王義恭來奔，奉表上尊號。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the Grand General, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, came to join him and submitted a memorial proposing his imperial title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Grand General, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, came over to his side and submitted a memorial urging him to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上至于新亭。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, he arrived at Xinting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he reached Xinting.

sentences.zh: 己巳，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，文武賜爵一等，從軍者二等。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire; civil and military officials were each granted one rank of nobility, and those who had followed the army received two.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty; civil and military officials each received one step in rank, and those who had served in the campaign received two.

sentences.zh: 贓汙清議，悉皆盪除。

translations.literal: Corruption and censorious judgments were all swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Charges of corruption and censorious judgments were all cleared away.

sentences.zh: 高年、鰥寡、孤幼、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: The aged, widowed, orphaned, young, and those suffering the six infirmities who could not support themselves were each given five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Those who were elderly, widowed, orphaned, young, or afflicted with the six infirmities and could not support themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 逋租宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: Overdue rents and old debts were no longer to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: Overdue rents and old debts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 長徒之身，優量降宥。

translations.literal: Those sentenced to long-term penal service received commuted sentences according to generous measure.
translations.idiomatic: Sentences of long-term penal service were commuted under a generous measure of clemency.

sentences.zh: 崇改太祖號諡。

translations.literal: He honored and revised the founding emperor's posthumous title and temple name.
translations.idiomatic: He elevated and revised the founding emperor's posthumous title and temple name.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍江夏王義恭為太尉、錄尚書六條事、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: The Grand General, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was made Grand Marshal, Director of the Six Articles of the Secretariat, and Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand General, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was made Grand Marshal, given charge of the Six Articles of the Secretariat, and appointed Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以荊州刺史南譙王義宣為中書監、丞相、錄尚書六條事、揚州刺史，安東將軍隨王誕為衞將軍、開府儀同三司、荊州刺史，雍州刺史臧質為車騎將軍、開府儀同三司、江州刺史，征虜將軍沈慶之為領軍將軍，撫軍將軍、兗冀二州刺史蕭思話為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, was made Director of the Secretariat, Chancellor, Director of the Six Articles of the Secretariat, and Inspector of Yangzhou; the General Who Pacifies the East, Prince Suixing Dan, was made General of the Guard, with credentials equal to an open office, and Inspector of Jingzhou; the Inspector of Yongzhou Zang Zhi was made General of the Chariots and Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office, and Inspector of Jiangzhou; the General Who Pacifies the Barbarians Shen Qingzhi was made General of the Palace Garrison; the General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yan and Ji, Xiao Sihua, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Inspector of Jingzhou, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, was made Director of the Secretariat, Chancellor, and director of the Six Articles, with the post of Inspector of Yangzhou; General Who Pacifies the East Prince Suixing Dan was made General of the Guard with credentials equal to an open office and Inspector of Jingzhou; Inspector of Yongzhou Zang Zhi was made General of the Chariots and Cavalry with open-office credentials and Inspector of Jiangzhou; General Who Pacifies the Barbarians Shen Qingzhi was made General of the Palace Garrison; and General Who Pacifies the Army Xiao Sihua, Inspector of Yan and Ji, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以征虜將軍王僧達為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the General Who Pacifies the Barbarians Wang Sengda was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen General Who Pacifies the Barbarians Wang Sengda was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 改新亭為中興亭。

translations.literal: Xinting was renamed Zhongxing Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Xinting was renamed Zhongxing Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌，輔國將軍申坦克京城。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the fifth month, the General Who Assists the State Shen Tank captured the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the fifth month General Who Assists the State Shen Tank took the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，輔國將軍朱脩之克東府。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the General Who Assists the State Zhu Xiuzhi captured the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai General Who Assists the State Zhu Xiuzhi took the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，克定京邑。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the capital was secured.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the capital was secured.

sentences.zh: [2]劭及始興王濬諸同逆並伏誅。

translations.literal: Shao and Prince Shixing Jun and all their fellow rebels were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Shao, Prince Shixing Jun, and all their fellow conspirators were put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔曰︰「天步艱難，國道用否，雖基構永固，而氣數時愆。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen an edict was issued: The steps of Heaven are arduous; the way of the state now falters. Though the foundation is ever firm, the span of fortune at times goes awry.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict declared: Heaven's course is arduous and the state's way now falters; though the foundation stands firm, fortune's span at times goes awry.

sentences.zh: 朕以眇身，奄承皇業，奉尋曆命，鑒寐震懷。

translations.literal: With this slight person I have suddenly received the imperial enterprise; in reverence for the mandate of succession, I tremble whether waking or sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: I, slight in person, have suddenly inherited the imperial enterprise; holding the mandate of succession in awe, I tremble waking and sleeping.

sentences.zh: 萬邦風政，人治之本，感念陵替，若疚在心。

translations.literal: The customs and government of the myriad regions are the root of human order; thinking how they have declined, I feel guilt as though it were a sickness in the heart.
translations.idiomatic: The customs and governance of the realm are the root of human order; when I think how they have fallen into ruin, the pain is like sickness in my heart.

sentences.zh: 可分遣大使巡省方俗。

translations.literal: Great envoys may be dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs in each region.
translations.idiomatic: Let great envoys be sent out to tour the provinces and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 」是日解嚴。

translations.literal: That day the emergency regulations were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emergency regulations were lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕幸東府城。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Palace city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the imperial carriage visited the Eastern Palace quarter.

sentences.zh: 甲申，尊所生路淑媛為皇太后。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, his biological mother, Lady Lu Shuyuan, was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen his birth mother, Lady Lu Shuyuan, was honored as Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Consort Wang was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Consort Wang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以左衞將軍柳元景為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the General of the Left Guard Liu Yuanda was made Inspector of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi General of the Left Guard Liu Yuanda was made Inspector of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以太尉江夏王義恭為太傅，領大司馬。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the Grand Marshal, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, was made Grand Tutor and concurrently Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was made Grand Tutor while retaining the post of Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曲赦京邑二百里內，并蠲今年租稅。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, a partial amnesty was granted within two hundred li of the capital, and this year's rents and taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a partial amnesty was proclaimed within two hundred li of the capital, and this year's rents and taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以撫軍將軍南平王鑠為司空，建平王宏為尚書左僕射，東海王褘為撫軍將軍，新除尚書左僕射蕭思話遷職。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the General Who Pacifies the Army, Prince of Nanping Shuo, was made Minister of Works; Prince of Jianping Hong was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Prince of Donghai Hui was made General Who Pacifies the Army; and the newly appointed Left Vice Director Xiao Sihua was transferred to another post.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu General Who Pacifies the Army Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Minister of Works; Prince of Jianping Hong was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat; Prince of Donghai Hui was made General Who Pacifies the Army; and the newly appointed Left Vice Director Xiao Sihua was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，以驃騎參軍垣護之為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the sixth month, the Rapid Cavalry Staff Officer Yuan Huzhi was made Inspector of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the sixth month Rapid Cavalry Staff Officer Yuan Huzhi was made Inspector of Ji.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以山陽太守申恬為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Administrator of Shanyang Shen Tian was made Inspector of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Administrator of Shanyang Shen Tian was made Inspector of Qing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 初置殿門及上閤屯兵。

translations.literal: Garrison troops for the palace gates and upper pavilions were established for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time garrison troops were posted at the palace gates and upper pavilions.

sentences.zh: 以江夏內史朱脩之為平西將軍、雍州刺史，御史中丞王曇生為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: The Interior Administrator of Jiangxia Zhu Xiuzhi was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yongzhou; the Imperial Censor Wang Tansheng was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: The Interior Administrator of Jiangxia Zhu Xiuzhi was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Yongzhou; Imperial Censor Wang Tansheng was made Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以新除雍州刺史柳元景為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the newly appointed Inspector of Yongzhou Liu Yuanda was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the newly appointed Inspector of Yongzhou Liu Yuanda was made General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以司州刺史魯爽為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the Inspector of Si Lu Shuang was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Inspector of Si Lu Shuang was made Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: [3]庚戌，以梁、南秦二州刺史劉秀之為益州刺史，太尉司馬龐秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史，衞軍司馬徐遺寶為兗州刺史，寧朔將軍王玄謨為徐州刺史，衞將軍隨王誕進號驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin Liu Xiuzhi was made Inspector of Yi; the Grand Marshal's Staff Officer Pang Xiuzhi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; the General of the Guard's Staff Officer Xu Yibao was made Inspector of Yan; the General Who Pacifies the North Wang Xuanmo was made Inspector of Xu; and General of the Guard Prince Suixing Dan was promoted to General of the Rapid Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin Liu Xiuzhi was made Inspector of Yi; Grand Marshal's Staff Officer Pang Xiuzhi was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin; General of the Guard's Staff Officer Xu Yibao was made Inspector of Yan; General Who Pacifies the North Wang Xuanmo was made Inspector of Xu; and General of the Guard Prince Suixing Dan was promoted to General of the Rapid Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尚書右僕射王僧達遷職，丹陽尹褚湛之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Sengda was transferred to another post; the Administrator of Danyang Chu Zhi was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Wang Sengda was reassigned; Administrator of Danyang Chu Zhi was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以侍中南譙王世子恢為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the heir of the Prince of Nanqiao, Attendant-in-ordinary, was made Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the heir of Prince of Nanqiao, Attendant-in-ordinary, was made Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，[4]詔曰︰「興王立訓，務弘治節，輔臣佐時，勤獻政要，仰惟聖規，每存茲道。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi an edict was issued: In establishing a state and raising up instruction, one must broadly enact governing norms; assisting ministers in their time must diligently present the essentials of government—looking up to the sage's plan, one always keeps this path in mind.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi an edict declared: In founding a state and setting up instruction, governing norms must be broadly enacted; ministers assisting the throne must diligently present the essentials of government—in reverence for the sage's design, this path must always be kept in view.

sentences.zh: 猥以眇躬，屬承景業，闡揚遺澤，無廢厥心。

translations.literal: Unworthy with this slight person, I have suddenly received the glorious enterprise; to extend and exalt the legacy left behind, I dare not slacken in heart.
translations.idiomatic: I, slight in person, have suddenly inherited the glorious enterprise; to extend and exalt the legacy bequeathed to me, I dare not slacken in heart.

sentences.zh: 夫量入為出，邦有恒典，而經給之宜，多違常度。

translations.literal: Measuring income to set expenditure is the state's constant rule, yet in what is needed for administration and supply, one too often departs from the regular standard.
translations.idiomatic: Matching income to expenditure is the state's constant rule, yet administrative needs too often depart from the regular standard.

sentences.zh: 兵役糜耗，府藏散減，外內眾供，未加損約，非所以聿遵先旨，敬奉遺圖。

translations.literal: Military service wastes resources and the treasury's stores dwindle; the many expenses inside and outside have not yet been reduced—this is not how to follow the former mandate and reverently keep the legacy map.
translations.idiomatic: Military service drains resources and the treasury dwindles; expenses within and without have not yet been cut—this is not how to follow the former mandate and keep the legacy design.

sentences.zh: 自今諸可薄己厚民、去煩從簡者，悉宜施行，以稱朕意。

translations.literal: From now on, whatever may thin the self to enrich the people and remove trouble in favor of simplicity should all be put into effect, to accord with my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth whatever may ease burdens on the people, remove excess, and favor simplicity should be enacted, to accord with my intent.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，詔有司論功班賞各有差。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict ordered the relevant offices to discuss merit and distribute rewards, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict ordered the relevant offices to assess merit and distribute rewards in due gradation.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，安西將軍、西秦河二州刺史吐谷渾拾寅進號鎮西大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of the two provinces of Western Qin and the Yellow River, Tuyuhun Shibin, was promoted to General Who Guards the West, with credentials equal to an open office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou General Who Pacifies the West Tuyuhun Shibin, Inspector of Western Qin and the Yellow River, was promoted to General Who Guards the West with credentials equal to an open office.

sentences.zh: 庚午，還分南徐立南兗州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Southern Yan was again separated from Southern Xu and established as a province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Southern Yan was again split from Southern Xu and established as a separate province.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改封南譙王義宣為南郡王，隨王誕為竟陵王，義宣次子宜陽侯愷為宜陽縣王。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanjun; Prince Suixing Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingling; and Yixuan's second son, Marquis of Yiyang Kai, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanjun; Prince Suixing Dan as Prince of Jingling; and Yixuan's second son, Marquis of Yiyang Kai, as Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，以領軍將軍沈慶之為鎮軍將軍、南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the intercalary month, the General of the Palace Garrison Shen Qingzhi was made General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renshen, General of the Palace Garrison Shen Qingzhi was made General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以護軍將軍柳元景為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the General Who Protects the Army Liu Yuanda was made General of the Palace Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou General Who Protects the Army Liu Yuanda was made General of the Palace Garrison.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣兼散騎常侍樂詢等十五人巡行風俗。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, fifteen men including the Acting Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Yue Xun were sent to tour and inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi fifteen envoys including Acting Regular Attendant Yue Xun were dispatched to tour the provinces and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，蠲尋陽、西陽郡租布三年。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, rents and cloth levies in the commanderies of Xunyang and Xiyang were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen rents and cloth levies in Xunyang and Xiyang were remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 甲午，丞相南郡王義宣改為荊、湘二州刺史，驃騎大將軍、荊州刺史竟陵王誕改為揚州刺史，南蠻校尉王僧達為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Chancellor, Prince of Nanjun Yixuan, was changed to Inspector of Jing and Xiang; the General of the Rapid Cavalry and Inspector of Jing, Prince of Jingling Dan, was changed to Inspector of Yang; and the Colonel of the Southern Man Wang Sengda was made General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Chancellor Prince of Nanjun Yixuan was reassigned as Inspector of Jing and Xiang; General of the Rapid Cavalry Prince of Jingling Dan as Inspector of Yang; and Colonel of the Southern Man Wang Sengda as General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 是月，置衞尉官。

translations.literal: That month the office of Commandant of the Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: That month the office of Commandant of the Guard was established.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, autumn, xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔曰︰「世道未夷，惟憂在國。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin an edict was issued: The age's way is not yet at peace; my sole worry is for the state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict declared: The age is not yet at peace; my sole worry is for the state.

sentences.zh: 夫使羣善畢舉，固非一才所議，況以寡德，屬衰薄之期，夙宵寅想，永懷待旦。

translations.literal: To bring all excellence to completion is truly not a matter one talent can deliberate; how much more, with my slight virtue, inheriting a time of decline and thin fortune, do I rise early and sleep late, ever thinking of the dawn.
translations.idiomatic: To gather every good counsel is not work for a single talent; how much more, with my slight virtue in a time of decline, do I rise at dawn and lie down late, ever awaiting the morning light.

sentences.zh: 王公卿士，凡有嘉謀善政，可以維風訓俗，咸達乃誠，無或依隱。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and ministers—whoever has excellent plans or good policies that may uphold customs and train the people—let all reach me in full sincerity, and let none conceal anything.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, dukes, and ministers: whoever has counsel or policy that may uphold customs and train the people, let it reach me in full sincerity, with nothing held back.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，詔曰：「百姓勞弊，傜賦尚繁，言念未乂，宜崇約損。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou an edict was issued: The common people are worn with hardship; corvée and levies remain heavy; thinking that order is not yet restored, frugality and reduction should be honored.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict declared: The people are worn with hardship and levies remain heavy; since order is not yet restored, frugality and reduction must be honored.

sentences.zh: 凡用非軍國，宜悉停功。

translations.literal: Whatever is not needed for army and state should altogether cease work.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever does not serve army and state should cease at once.

sentences.zh: 可省細作并尚方，雕文靡巧，金銀塗飾，事不關實，嚴為之禁。

translations.literal: Fine workshops and the Imperial Workshop may be reduced; carved ornament and extravagant craft, gilding of gold and silver—matters that do not touch substance—are strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Fine workshops and the Imperial Workshop should be cut back; carved ornament, extravagant craft, and gilding of gold and silver—things without real use—are strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 供御服膳，減除遊侈。

translations.literal: Imperial meals and apparel should be reduced, and wandering excess removed.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial meals and apparel should be simplified and wandering excess cut away.

sentences.zh: 水陸捕採，各順時月。

translations.literal: Land and water hunting and gathering should each follow its season.
translations.idiomatic: Hunting and gathering on land and water should each follow its proper season.

sentences.zh: 官私交市，務令優衷。

translations.literal: Official and private market exchange should be made to lean toward fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Trade between government and private parties should be kept fair.

sentences.zh: 其江海田池公家規固者，詳所開弛。

translations.literal: As for rivers, seas, fields, and ponds held under state regulation, a detailed report should be made on what may be opened or relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: State-controlled rivers, seas, fields, and ponds should be reviewed in detail for what may be opened or relaxed.

sentences.zh: 貴戚競利，悉皆禁絕。

translations.literal: Nobles and kin competing for profit are all to be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Competition for profit among the nobility and imperial kin is forbidden altogether.

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，[5]以右衞將軍宗慤為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the General of the Right Guard Zong Que was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu General of the Right Guard Zong Que was made Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，司空南平王鑠薨。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Minister of Works, Prince of Nanping Shuo, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Minister of Works Prince of Nanping Shuo died.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，武皇帝舊役軍身，嘗在齋內，人身猶存者，普賜解戶。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the eighth month, among the old military households of Emperor Wu who had once served in the inner quarters and whose persons still survived, a general grant of release from household registers was given.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the eighth month, among Emperor Wu's old military households who had once served in the inner quarters and still survived, release from household registers was granted broadly.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，尚書左僕射建平王宏加中書監、中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Jianping Hong, was given the additional posts of Director of the Secretariat and General of the Central Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Left Vice Director Prince of Jianping Hong was given the additional posts of Director of the Secretariat and General of the Central Army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以沛郡太守垣閎為寧州刺史，撫軍司馬費沈為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Administrator of Pei Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Ning; the Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the Army Fei Shen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Administrator of Pei Yuan Hong was made Inspector of Ning; Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the Army Fei Shen was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 甲午，護軍將軍王僧達遷職。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the General Who Protects the Army Wang Sengda was transferred to another post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu General Who Protects the Army Wang Sengda was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，以前尚書劉義綦為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the ninth month, the former Minister of the Secretariat Liu Yiji was made General of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the ninth month former Minister of the Secretariat Liu Yiji was made General of the Palace Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，新亭戰亡者，復同京城。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, those who died in battle at Xinting received the same benefits as the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the dead of the Xinting battle received the same benefits as those of the capital.

sentences.zh: 劭黨南海太守蕭簡據廣州反。

translations.literal: A partisan of Shao, the Administrator of Nanhai Xiao Jian, seized Guangzhou in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shao's partisan, Administrator of Nanhai Xiao Jian, held Guangzhou in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，輔國將軍鄧琬討平之。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the General Who Assists the State Deng Wan suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao General Who Assists the State Deng Wan suppressed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，車駕於閱武堂聽訟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guiwei, the imperial carriage heard cases at the Review of Arms Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei, the emperor heard cases at the Review of Arms Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，以左軍將軍魯秀為司州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingwu, the General of the Left Army Lu Xiu was made Inspector of Si.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu, General of the Left Army Lu Xiu was made Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，停臺省眾官朔望問訊。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the first- and fifteenth-day audience visits of all officials of the Secretariat and provinces were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the new- and full-moon audience visits of Secretariat and provincial officials were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，省都水臺，罷都水使者官，置水衡令官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, the Directorate of Waterways was reduced; the office of Commissioner of Waterways was abolished and the office of Director of Water Balance was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the twelfth month the Directorate of Waterways was cut back, the Commissioner of Waterways was abolished, and the Director of Water Balance was appointed.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以將置東宮，省太子率更令、步兵、翊軍校尉、旅賁中郎將、宂從僕射、左右積弩將軍官。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, because the Eastern Palace was about to be established, the offices of Director of the Crown Prince's Household, Colonel of Footsoldiers, Colonel of the Assist Army, Colonel of the Garrison Cavalry, Regular of the Palace Retinue, and Generals of the Left and Right Strong Crossbows were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, as the Eastern Palace was being set up, the Director of the Crown Prince's Household and the offices of Colonel of Footsoldiers, Colonel of the Assist Army, Colonel of the Garrison Cavalry, Regular of the Palace Retinue, and Generals of the Left and Right Strong Crossbows were abolished.

sentences.zh: 中庶子、中舍人、庶子、舍人、洗馬，各減舊員之半。

translations.literal: The Household Attendants, Household Gentlemen, Crown Prince's Sons, Gentlemen, and Groom, each had their staffs reduced by half from the former number.
translations.idiomatic: Household Attendants, Household Gentlemen, Crown Prince's Sons, Gentlemen, and Grooms each had their staffs cut by half.

sentences.zh: 孝建元年春正月己亥朔，車駕親祠南郊，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Xiaojian, jihai, the imperial carriage in person sacrificed at the Southern Suburb, the era name was changed, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of Xiaojian, jihai, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person, changed the era name, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以丹陽尹蕭思話為安北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Administrator of Danyang Xiao Sihua was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Administrator of Danyang Xiao Sihua was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，護軍將軍劉義綦遷職，以尚書令何尚之為左光祿大夫、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the General Who Protects the Army Liu Yiji was transferred to another post; the Minister of the Secretariat He Shangzhi was made Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen General Who Protects the Army Liu Yiji was reassigned; Minister of the Secretariat He Shangzhi was made Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「首食尚農，經邦本務，貢士察行，寧朝當道。

translations.literal: On the day wushen an edict was issued: Food is the first concern and agriculture the foundation of governing the state; presenting scholars and examining conduct are what should guide the court.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict declared: Food comes first and agriculture is the root of government; presenting scholars and examining conduct should guide the court.

sentences.zh: 內難甫康，政訓未洽，衣食有仍耗之弊，選造無觀國之美。

translations.literal: Domestic troubles have only just been settled and government instruction is not yet harmonized; clothing and food still suffer constant waste, and in selection and appointment there is no beauty of observing the state.
translations.idiomatic: Domestic troubles are barely settled and instruction is not yet unified; food and clothing still waste away, and in appointments there is no regard for service to the state.

sentences.zh: 昔衞文勤民，高宗恭默，卒能收賢巖穴，大殷季年。

translations.literal: In former times Duke Wen of Wei toiled for the people and Emperor Gaozong of the Shang kept reverent silence; in the end they were able to gather worthies from mountain caves and greatly prosper in their late years.
translations.idiomatic: Of old Duke Wen of Wei toiled for the people and Emperor Gaozong kept reverent silence, and in the end gathered worthies from the hills and greatly prospered in their late years.

sentences.zh: 朕每側席疚懷，無忘鑒寐。

translations.literal: I constantly sit sideways with guilt in my breast, never forgetting this whether waking or sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: I constantly sit with unease in my heart, never forgetting this waking or sleeping.

sentences.zh: 凡諸守莅親民之官，可詳申舊條，勤盡地利。

translations.literal: All officials in charge of districts who are close to the people should report in detail according to the old regulations and diligently exhaust the land's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: All local officials charged with caring for the people should report in detail under the old regulations and make full use of the land's yield.

sentences.zh: [6]力田善蓄者，在所具以名聞。

translations.literal: Those who work the fields well and store grain wisely should be listed by name at their location.
translations.idiomatic: Those who farm diligently and store grain well should be reported by name from each district.

sentences.zh: 褒甄之科，精為其格。

translations.literal: The standards for rewards and commendation should be made precise in their rules.
translations.idiomatic: Standards for rewards and commendation should be set with precision.

sentences.zh: 四方秀孝，非才勿舉，獻答允值，即就銓擢。

translations.literal: Outstanding filial sons from the four directions should not be recommended unless they have talent; if their presentations and answers are satisfactory, they should at once be selected and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding filial sons from the four directions should not be recommended without talent; if their answers are satisfactory, they should be promoted at once.

sentences.zh: 若止無可採，猶賜除署；

translations.literal: If in the end there is nothing worth selecting, they should still be granted removal from common status and appointment;
translations.idiomatic: If nothing worth selecting is found, they should still be granted appointment;

sentences.zh: 若有不堪酬奉，虛竊榮薦，遣還田里，加以禁錮。

translations.literal: if any cannot answer their charge and vainly usurp honor through recommendation, send them back to their villages and impose prohibition and confinement.
translations.idiomatic: but if any cannot meet their charge and vainly seize honor through recommendation, send them back to their villages under prohibition.

sentences.zh: 尚書百官之元本，庶績之樞機，丞郎列曹，局司有在。

translations.literal: The Secretariat is the origin of the hundred officials and the pivot of the many achievements; the assistants, gentlemen, and various bureaus each have their offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat is the root of the hundred officials and the pivot of all achievement; assistants, gentlemen, and the various bureaus each have their duties.

sentences.zh: 而頃事無巨細，悉歸令僕，非所以眾材成構，羣能濟業者也。

translations.literal: Yet recently matters great and small have all been returned to the Directors and Vice Directors—this is not how the many talents complete the structure and the many abilities accomplish the work.
translations.idiomatic: Yet lately matters great and small all go to the Directors and Vice Directors—not how many talents build the structure and many abilities accomplish the work.

sentences.zh: 可更明體制，咸責厥成，糾覈勤惰，嚴施賞罰。

translations.literal: The system may be clarified anew; all should be charged with fulfilling their tasks, diligence and sloth investigated and assessed, and rewards and punishments strictly applied.
translations.idiomatic: The system should be clarified anew; each should be charged with his task, diligence and sloth investigated, and rewards and punishments strictly applied.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，更鑄四銖錢。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the four-zhu coin was cast anew.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the four-zhu coin was recast.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，立皇子子業為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the imperial son Ziye was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the imperial son Ziye was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 賜天下為父後者爵一級。

translations.literal: Throughout the empire, those who were heirs as sons to their fathers were each granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the empire, heirs as sons to their fathers each received one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 孝子、順孫、義夫、節婦粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives received grain and silk each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives received grain and silk in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 是月，起正光殿。

translations.literal: That month construction of the Hall of Correct Radiance was begun.
translations.idiomatic: That month work began on the Hall of Correct Radiance.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，豫州刺史魯爽、車騎將軍江州刺史臧質、丞相荊州刺史南郡王義宣、兗州刺史徐遺寶舉兵反。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengwu, the Inspector of Yu Lu Shuang, the General of the Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Zang Zhi, the Chancellor and Inspector of Jing Prince of Nanjun Yixuan, and the Inspector of Yan Xu Yibao all raised armies in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the second month Inspector of Yu Lu Shuang, General of the Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Jiang Zang Zhi, Chancellor and Inspector of Jing Prince of Nanjun Yixuan, and Inspector of Yan Xu Yibao all rebelled.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，撫軍將軍東海王褘遷職。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the General Who Pacifies the Army Prince of Donghai Hui was transferred to another post.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai General Who Pacifies the Army Prince of Donghai Hui was reassigned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，領軍將軍柳元景加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanda was given the additional post of General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanda was also made General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬午，曲赦豫州。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a partial amnesty was granted in Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，左衞將軍王玄謨為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the General of the Left Guard Wang Xuanmo was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao General of the Left Guard Wang Xuanmo was made Inspector of Yu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，玄謨進據梁山。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Xuanmo advanced and took position at Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xuanmo advanced and occupied Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以安北司馬夏侯祖歡為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the North Xia Hou Zuhuan was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Staff Officer of the General Who Pacifies the North Xia Hou Zuhuan was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，[7]內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guihai, emergency regulations were imposed inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai, emergency regulations were imposed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以安北將軍、徐州刺史蕭思話為安南將軍、江州刺史，撫軍將軍柳元景即本號為雍州刺史。

庚午，護軍將軍劉延孫遷職，右衞將軍湘東王彧為中護軍。
京邑雨水，辛未，遣使檢行，賜以樵米。
二月己亥，復親民職公田。
索虜寇兗州。
三月壬戌，制大臣加班劍者，不得入宮城門。
梁州獠求內屬，立懷漢郡。
夏四月，京邑疾疫，丙申，遣使按行，賜給醫藥。
死而無收斂者，官為斂埋。
庚子，省湘州宋建郡并臨賀。
五月，吳興、義興大水，民饑。
乙卯，遣使開倉賑卹。
癸酉，於華林園聽訟。
乙亥，以左衞將軍沈曇慶為徐州刺史，輔國將軍梁瑾葱為河州刺史、宕昌王。
六月己卯，以前太子步兵校尉劉祗子歆繼南豐王朗。
辛巳，以長水校尉山陽王休祐為東揚州刺史。
丁亥，休祐改為湘州刺史。
以丹陽尹顏竣為東揚州刺史。
秋七月辛未，土斷雍州諸僑郡縣。
八月戊戌，於兗州立陽平郡。
壬寅，於華林園聽訟。
甲辰，司空、南徐州刺史竟陵王誕改為南兗州刺史，太子詹事劉延孫為鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史。
冬十月丙申，詔曰：「旒纊之道，有孚於結繩，日昃之勤，已切於姬后。
況世弊教淺，歲月澆季。
朕雖勠力宇內，未明求衣，而識狹前王，務廣昔代，永言菲德，其愧良深。
朝咨野怨，自達者寡，惠民利公，所昧實眾。
自今百辟庶尹，下民賤隸，有懷誠抱志，擁鬱衡閭，失理負謗，未聞朝聽者，皆聽躬自申奏，小大以聞。
朕因聽政之日，親對覽焉。
」甲辰，以百濟王餘慶為鎮東大將軍。
十二月丁亥，順陽王休範改封桂陽王。
戊戌，於華林園聽訟。
二年春正月辛亥，車駕祀南郊。
壬子，詔曰：「去歲東土多經水災。
春務已及，宜加優課。
糧種所須，以時貸給。
」丙辰，復郡縣田秩，并九親祿俸。
壬戌，詔曰：「先帝靈命初興，龍飛西楚，歲紀浸遠，感往纏心。
奉迎文武，情深常隸，思弘殊澤，以申永懷。
吏身可賜爵一級，軍戶免為平民。」
二月丙子，詔曰：「政道未著，俗弊尚深，豪侈兼并，貧弱困窘，存闕衣裳，沒無斂槥，朕甚傷之。
其明敕守宰，勤加存卹。
賻贈之科，速為條品。
」乙酉，以金紫光祿大夫褚湛之為尚書左僕射。
丙戌，中書監、尚書令、衞將軍建平王宏以本號開府儀同三司，中書監如故。
丁酉，驃騎將軍柳元景以本號開府儀同三司。
甲辰，散騎常侍義陽王昶為中軍將軍。
三月丁未，中書監、尚書令、衞將軍建平王宏薨。
乙卯，以田農要月，太官停殺牛。
丁卯，上於華林園聽訟。
癸酉，以寧朔將軍劉季之為司州刺史。
夏四月甲申，立皇子子綏為安陸王。
甲午，以海陵王休茂為雍州刺史。
辛丑，地震。
五月戊申，復西陽郡。

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, Gao Ge of Pengcheng and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Director of the Secretariat Wang Sengda, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu General Who Pacifies the North Shen Sengrong was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

translations.idiomatic: On renxu General Who Pacifies the North Liu Daolong was made Inspector of Xu.

translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck Xiangyang; envoys were sent to tour the region and grant relief.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the posts of General of the Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of the Martial Cavalry were established.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiawu, General of the Central Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was made Inspector of Jiang.

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengzi, an edict declared: Those who dwell in mountains and live on cliffs do not take fish and turtle as ritual offerings.

translations.idiomatic: In recent years there has been much trouble; military levies have been urgent. Levies contrary to local custom were meant for a moment's need, yet officials have grown accustomed to them and they have become regular practice.

translations.idiomatic: Pawlonia, catalpa, jade, and fine stone—each land should offer what it produces; yet when trifles accumulate, deep harm follows in the end.

sentences.zh: 永言弘革，無替朕心。

translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of broad reform, let it not fall short of my intent.

translations.idiomatic: All tribute duties of the capital region and products gathered from mountains and marshes must be examined as to what each place produces and assessed by season, so that forced quotas are not imposed in vain and the natural order is not violated.

translations.idiomatic: Thus may the wind of simplicity win trust in character;

translations.idiomatic: On jichou General Who Pacifies the Cavalry and General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Masters of Writing, and Right Vice Director Liu Zunkao was made General of the Palace Garrison.

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the state of Bohuang sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Bohuang sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Administrator of Yixing Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Yan.

translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Administrator of Jianning Fu Zhongzi was made Inspector of Ning.

translations.idiomatic: Long-term convicts of the Imperial Workshop and aged or sick palace women and eunuch slaves were all pardoned and released.

translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives each received grain and silk in graded amounts.

translations.idiomatic: Poor households in the metropolitan domain and along the route of the recent imperial halt were all exempted from rent for one year.

translations.idiomatic: The Court of Justice receives doubtful cases from far and near; fair judgment is its charge—yet once one enters the dark prison, years often pass.

translations.idiomatic: The people bear this hardship; officials indulge their private interests.

translations.idiomatic: From this day forward, when prisoners have completed their statements, report at once; I shall review and decide all in detail, so that no case remains in prison.

translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the King of Hexi, the Great Juqu Anzhou, was made General Who Conquers the Barbarians and Inspector of Liang.

translations.idiomatic: Sushen, through repeated interpreters, presented arrow-wood shafts and stone whistling-balls.

translations.idiomatic: The Western Regions presented dancing horses.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, General Who Conquers the Champions Prince of Baling Xiuruo was made Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以安陸王子綏為郢州刺史。
癸酉，以徐州刺史劉道隆為青、冀二州刺史。
索虜寇北陰平孔堤，太守楊歸子擊破之。
甲申，皇后親桑于西郊。
夏四月癸卯，以南琅邪隸王畿。
丙午，詔曰：「昔紩衣御宇，貶甘示節；
土簋臨天，飭儉昭度。
朕綈帛之念，無忘于懷。
雖深詔有司，省游務實，而歲用兼積，年量虛廣。
豈以捐豐從損，允稱約心。
四時供限，可詳減太半。
庶裘絺順典，有偃民華；
纂組傷工，無競㙻市。
」辛酉，詔曰：「都邑節氣未調，疫癘猶眾，言念民瘼，情有矜傷。
可遣使存問，并給醫藥；
其死亡者，隨宜卹贍。」
五月庚辰，於華林園聽訟。
乙酉，以徐州之梁郡還屬豫州。
丙戌，尚書左僕射褚湛之卒。
以撫軍長史劉思考為益州刺史。
庚寅，以南下邳併南彭城郡。
秋七月甲戌，左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司何尚之薨。
八月壬寅，宕昌王遣使獻方物。
己酉，以晉安王子勛為南兗州刺史。
雍州大水，甲寅，遣軍部賑給。
九月辛未，以冠軍將軍垣護之為豫州刺史。
甲申，上於華林園聽訟。
丁亥，改封襄陽王子鸞為新安王。
冬十月庚寅，遣新除司空沈慶之討沿江蠻。
壬辰，制郡縣減祿，並先充公限。
十一月戊辰，改細作署令為左右御府令。
丙戌，復置大司農官。
十二月乙未，上於華林園聽訟。
辛丑，[17]車駕幸廷尉寺，凡囚繫咸悉原遣。
索虜遣使請和。
丁未，車駕幸建康縣，原放獄囚。
倭國遣使獻方物。
五年春正月丁卯，以宕昌王梁唐子為河州刺史。
二月癸巳，車駕閱武。
詔曰：「昔人稱人道何先，於兵為首，雖淹紀勿用，忘之必危。
朕以聽覽餘閒，因時講事，坐作有儀，進退無爽。
軍幢以下，普量班錫。
頃化弗能孚，而民未知禁，逭役違調，起觸刑網。
凡諸逃亡，在今昧爽以前，悉皆原赦。
已滯囹圄者，釋還本役。
其逋負在大明三年以前，一賜原停。
自此以還，鰥貧疾老，詳所申減。
伐蠻之家，蠲租稅之半。
近籍改新制，在所承用，殊謬實多，可普更符下，聽以今為始。
若先已犯制，亦同蕩然。
」甲寅，加右光祿大夫羊玄保特進。
夏四月癸巳，改封西陽王子尚為豫章王。
丙申，加尚書令柳元景左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。
戊戌，詔曰：「南徐、兗二州去歲水潦傷年，民多困窶。
逋租未入者，可申至秋登。
」丙午，雍州刺史海陵王休茂殺司馬庾深之，舉兵反，義成太守薛繼考討斬之。
[18]甲寅，以第九皇子子仁為雍州刺史。
五月癸亥，制帝室期親，朝官非祿官者，月給錢十萬。
丙辰，車駕幸閱武堂聽訟。
六月丙午，以護軍將軍義陽王昶為中軍將軍。
壬子，分廣陵置沛郡，省東平郡并廣陵。
秋七月丙辰，詔曰：「雨水猥降，街衢泛溢。
可遣使巡行。
窮弊之家，賜以薪粟。
」丁卯，高麗國遣使獻方物。
庚午，曲赦雍州。
八月戊子，立第九皇子子仁為永嘉王，第十一皇子子真為始安王。
以北中郎參軍費伯弘為寧州刺史。
己丑，詔曰：「自靈命初基，聖圖重遠。
參正樂職，感神明之應；
崇殖禮囿，奮至德之光。
聲實同和，文以均節，化調其俗，物性其情。
故臨經式奠，煥乎炳發，道喪世屯，學落年永。
獄訟微衰息之術，百姓忘退素之方。
今息警夷嶂，恬波河渚，棧山航海，嚮風慕義，化民成俗，茲焉時矣。
[19]來歲可修葺庠序，旌延國冑。
」庚寅，制方鎮所假白板郡縣，年限依臺除，食祿三分之一，不給送故。
衞將軍東海王褘以本號開府儀同三司。
九月甲寅朔，日有食之。
丁卯，行幸琅邪郡，囚繫悉原遣。
甲戌，移南豫州治淮南于湖縣。
丁丑，以冠軍將軍尋陽王子房為南豫州刺史。
閏月戊子，皇太子妃何氏薨。
丙申，初立馳道，自閶闔門至于朱雀門，又自承明門至于玄武湖。
壬寅，改封歷陽王子頊為臨海王。
冬十月甲寅，以車騎將軍、南徐州刺史劉延孫為尚書左僕射、領護軍將軍，尚書右僕射劉秀之為安北將軍、雍州刺史。
以冠軍將軍臨海王子頊為廣州刺史。
乙卯，以東中郎將新安王子鸞為南徐州刺史。
十一月壬辰，詔曰：「王畿內奉京師，外表眾夏，民殷務廣，宜思簡惠。
可遣尚書就加詳檢，并與守宰平治庶獄。
其有疑滯，具以狀聞。
」丁酉，增置少府丞一人。
十二月壬申，以領軍將軍劉遵考為尚書右僕射。
甲戌，制天下民戶歲輸布四疋。
庚辰，以太常王玄謨為平北將軍、徐州刺史。
六年春正月己丑，湘州刺史建安王休仁加平南將軍。
辛卯，車駕親祠南郊。
是日，又宗祀明堂。
大赦天下。
孝子、順孫、義夫、悌弟，賜爵一級，慈姑、節婦及孤老、六疾，賜帛五匹，穀十斛。
下四方旌賞茂異，其有懷真抱素，志行清白，恬退自守，不交當世，或識通古今，才經軍國，奉公廉直，高譽在民，具以名奏。
乙未，置五官中郎將、左右中郎將官。
二月乙卯，復百官祿。
三月庚寅，立第十三皇子子元為邵陵王。
壬寅，以倭國王世子興為安東將軍。
乙巳，改豫州南梁郡為淮南郡，舊淮南郡并宣城。
丁未，輔國將軍、征虜長史、廣陵太守沈懷文有罪，下獄死。
四月庚申，原除南兗州大明三年以前逋租。
新作大航門。
五月丙戌，置凌室，修藏冰之禮。
壬寅，太宰江夏王義恭解領司徒。
六月辛酉，尚書左僕射、護軍將軍劉延孫卒。
秋七月庚辰，以荊州刺史朱脩之為領軍將軍，廣州刺史臨海王子頊為荊州刺史。
甲申，地震。
戊子，以輔國將軍王翼之為廣州刺史。
辛卯，以西陽太守檀翼之為交州刺史。
乙未，立第十九皇子子雲為晉陵王。
八月癸亥，原除雍州大明四年以前逋租。
乙亥，置清臺令。
九月戊寅，制沙門致敬人主。
戊子，以前金紫光祿大夫宗慤為中護軍。
乙未，尚書右僕射劉遵考為尚書左僕射，丹陽尹王僧朗為尚書右僕射。
冬十月丁巳，以山陽王休祐子士弘繼鄱陽哀王休業。
丁卯，詔上林苑內民庶丘墓欲還合葬者，[21]勿禁。
七年春正月癸未，詔曰：「春蒐之禮，著自周令；
講事之語，書于魯史。
所以昭宣德度，示民軌則。
今歲稔氣榮，中外寧晏。
當因農隙，葺是舊章。
可克日於玄武湖大閱水師，并巡江右，講武校獵。
」丁亥，以尚書右僕射王僧朗為太常，衞將軍顏師伯為尚書右僕射。
己丑，以尚書令柳元景為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
庚寅，以南兗州刺史晉安王子勛為江州刺史。
癸巳，割吳郡屬南徐州。
二月甲寅，車駕巡南豫、南兗二州。
丙辰，詔曰：「江漢楚望，咸秩周禋，禮九疑於盛唐，祀蓬萊於渤海，皆前載流訓，列聖遺式。
霍山是曰南嶽，實維國鎮，韞靈呈瑞，肇光宋道。
朕駐驆于野，有事岐陽，瞻睇風雲，徘徊以想。
可遣使奠祭。
」丁巳，車駕校獵于歷陽之烏江。
己未，車駕登烏江縣六合山。
庚申，割歷陽秦郡置臨江郡。
壬戌，[22]詔曰：「朕受天慶命，十一年於茲矣。
憑七廟之靈，獲上帝之力，禮橫四海，威震八荒。
方巡三湘而奠衡嶽，次九河而檢云、岱。
今恢覽功成，省風畿表，觀民六合，蒐校長洲。
騰沙飛礫，平嶽盪海，鼖晉合序，鐃鉦協節，獻鬯如禮，饁獸傾郊，敬舉王公之觴，廣納士民之壽。
八風循通，卿雲叢聚，盡天罄瑞，率宇竭歡。
思散太極之泉，以福無方之外。
可大赦天下，行幸所經，無出今歲租布。
其逋租餘債，勿復收。
賜民爵一級，女子百戶牛酒。
刺守邑宰及民夫從蒐者，普加沾賚。
」[23]又詔曰：「朕弱年操製，出牧司雍，承政宣風，荐歷年紀。
國步中阻，治戎江甸，難夷情義，實繫于懷。
今或練蒐訓旅，涉茲境閭，故邑耆舊，在目罕存。
年世未遠，殲亡太半，撫迹惟事，傾慨兼著。
太宗燕故，晉陽洽恩；
世祖流仁，濟畿暢澤。
永言往猷，思廣前賚。
可蠲歷陽郡租輸三年。
遣使巡慰，問民疾苦，鰥寡、孤老、六疾不能自存者，厚賜粟帛。
高年加以羊酒。
凡一介之善，隨才銓貫；
前國名臣及府州佐吏，量所沾錫。
人身已往，施及子孫。
」壬申，車駕還宮。
夏四月甲寅，以領軍將軍朱脩之為特進。
丙辰，以尚書湘東王彧為領軍將軍。
甲子，詔曰：「自非臨軍戰陳，一不得專殺。
其罪甚重辟者，[24]皆如舊先上須報，有司嚴加聽察。
犯者以殺人罪論。」
五月乙亥，撫軍將軍、揚州刺史豫章王子尚進號車騎將軍，輔國將軍始安王子真為廣州刺史。
丙子，詔曰：「自今刺史守宰，動民興軍，皆須手詔施行。
唯邊隅外警，及姦釁內發，變起倉卒者，不從此例。」
六月甲辰，以北中郎司馬柳元怙為梁、南秦二州刺史。
戊申，芮芮國、高麗國遣使獻方物。
戊辰，以秦郡太守劉德願為豫州刺史。
七月乙亥，征東大將軍高麗王高璉進號車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
丙申，[25]詔曰：「前詔江海田池，與民共利。
歷歲未久，浸以弛替。
名山大川，往往占固。
有司嚴加檢糾，申明舊制。」
八月丁巳，詔曰：「昔匹婦含怨，山燋北鄙；
孀妻哀慟，臺傾東國。
良以誠之所動，在微必著；
感之所震，雖厚必崩。
朕臨察九野，志深待旦，弗能使爛然成章，各如其節。
遂令炎精損河，陽偏不施，歲云不稔，咎實朕由。
太官供膳，宜從貶撤。
近道刑獄，當親料省。
其王畿內及神州所統，可遣尚書與所在共詳；
畿外諸州，委之刺史。
并詳省律令，思存利民。
其考讁貿襲，在大明七年以前，一切勿治。
尤弊之家，開倉賑給。
」乙丑，立第十六皇子子孟為淮南王，第十八皇子子產為臨賀王。
車駕幸建康秣陵縣訊獄囚。
九月巳卯，詔曰：「近炎精亢序，苗稼多傷。
今二麥未晚，甘澤頻降，可下東境郡，勤課墾殖。
尤弊之家，量貸麥種。
」戊子，詔曰：「昔周王驥跡，實窮四溟；
漢帝鸞軫，夙遍五嶽。
皆所以上對幽靈，下理民土。
自天昌替馭，臨宮創圖，禮代夭鬱，世貿興毀。
皇家造宋，日月重光，琁璣得序，五星順命，而戎車歲動，陳詩義闕。
朕聿含五光，奄一天下，思盡寶戒之規，以塞謀危之路。
當沿時省方，觀察風俗。
外詳考舊典，以副側席之懷。
」庚寅，南徐州刺史新安王子鸞兼司徒。
乙未，車駕幸廷尉訊獄囚。
丙申，立第十七皇子子嗣為東平王。
冬十月壬寅，太子冠，賜王公以下帛各有差。
戊申，車駕巡南豫州。
詔曰：「朕巡幸所經，先見百年者，及孤寡老疾，並賜粟帛。
獄繫刑罪，並親聽訟。
其士庶或怨鬱危滯，受抑吏司，或隱約潔立，負擯州里，皆聽進朕前，面自陳訴。
若忠信孝義，力田殖穀，一介之能，一藝之美，悉加旌賞。
雖秋澤頻降，而夏旱嬰弊。
可即開行倉，[26]並加賑賜。
」癸丑，行幸江寧縣訊獄囚。
車騎將軍、揚州刺史豫章王子尚加開府儀同三司。
癸亥，衞將軍、開府儀同三司東海王褘為司空，中軍將軍義陽王昶加開府儀同三司。
丙寅，詔曰：「賞慶刑威，奄國彝軌；
黜幽升明，闢宇恒憲。
故採言聆風，式觀侈質，貶爵加地，於是乎在。
今類帝宜社，親巡江甸，因覲嶽守，躬求民瘼。
思弘明試之典，以申考績之義。
行幸所經，莅民之職，功宣於聽，即加甄賞。
若廢務亂民，隨諐議罰。
主者詳察以聞。
」己巳，車駕校獵於姑孰。
十二月丙午，行幸歷陽。
甲寅，大赦天下。
南豫州別署勅繫長徒，一切原散。
其兵期考襲讁戍，悉停。
歷陽郡女子百戶牛酒；
高年孤疾，賜帛十匹，蠲郡租十年。
己未，太宰江夏王義恭加尚書令。
於博望梁山立雙闕。
癸亥，車駕至自歷陽。
八年春正月甲戌，詔曰：「東境去歲不稔，宜廣商貨。
遠近販鬻米粟者，[29]可停道中雜稅。
其以仗自防，悉勿禁。
」癸未，安北將軍、雍州刺史劉秀之卒。
戊子，以平南將軍、湘州刺史建安王休仁為安南將軍、江州刺史，晉安王子勛為鎮軍將軍、雍州刺史，南徐州刺史新安王子鸞為撫軍將軍，[30]領司徒、刺史如故，輔國將軍江夏王世子伯禽為湘州刺史。
二月辛丑，特進朱脩之卒。
壬寅，詔曰：「去歲東境偏旱，田畝失收。
使命來者，多至乏絕。
或下窮流宂，頓伏街巷，朕甚閔之。
可出倉米付建康、秣陵二縣，隨宜贍恤。
若濟拯不時，[31]以至捐棄者，嚴加糾劾。
」乙巳，以鎮軍將軍湘東王彧為鎮北將軍、徐州刺史。
平北將軍、徐州刺史王玄謨為領軍將軍。
夏閏五月辛丑，以前御史中丞蕭惠開為青、冀二州刺史。
壬寅，太宰江夏王義恭領太尉。
特進、右光祿大夫羊玄保卒。
庚申，帝崩於玉燭殿，時年三十五。
秋七月丙午，葬丹陽秣陵縣巖山景寧陵。
史臣曰：役己以利天下，堯、舜之心也；
利己以及萬物，中主之志也；
盡民命以自養，桀、紂之行也。
觀大明之世，其將盡民命乎！
雖有周公之才之美，猶終之以亂，何益哉！
校勘記
徙都督雍梁南北秦四州荊州之襄陽竟陵南陽順陽新野隨六郡諸軍事 「南陽」各本作「南陵」。
錢大昕廿二史考異云：「南陵當作南陽。
」按州郡志，荊州有南陽郡，無「南陵郡」。
今從錢說改。
丙子克定京邑 「丙子」各本及南史作「丙申」。
建康實錄作「丙子」。
按是月癸酉朔，初二日甲戌，初三日乙亥，初四日丙子，二十四日丙申。
據上文，初二日甲戌克京口城，初三日乙亥克東府，克定京師，當在初四日丙子。
元凶傳，四日建康破，則作丙子是。
今據建康實錄改。
以司州刺史魯爽為豫州刺史 「豫州」各本並作「南豫州」。
廿二史考異云：「案是時無南豫州。
『南』蓋衍文也。
自永嘉二十二年罷南豫州并壽陽，至孝武大明三年始復分置，中間無南豫者計十年。
」按錢說是，今刪。
丁巳 各本並作「丁亥」。
孫虨宋書考論云：「丁亥蓋丁巳誤。
」按是月壬寅朔，無丁亥，十六日丁巳。
孫說是，今改正。
戊戌 孫虨宋書考論云：「以前後辛酉己巳推之，戊戌必譌。
」按是年七月辛丑朔，二十一日辛酉，二十九日己巳，無戊戌。
疑是二十二日壬戌或二十八日戊辰之誤。
勤盡地利 「勤」各本並作「勸」，據元龜一九一改。
三月癸亥 通鑑考異云：「宋本紀、宋略皆作癸亥，下有辛丑。
按長曆，是月戊戌朔，癸亥二十六日，辛丑乃四日也。
當作己亥。」
二月己丑 下有丙寅。
按是月壬戌朔，初四日丙寅，二十八日己丑，己丑不當在丙寅前。
疑己丑是乙丑之譌，乙丑為二月初三日。
有妨肄業 「肄」各本並作「肆」，據元龜一九五改。
九月丁亥 按本月己丑朔，二十二日庚戌，是月無丁亥。
以大司馬垣護之為青冀二州刺史 孫虨宋書考論云：「護之不得為大司馬，蓋大司馬僚佐也。
護之傳並脫。」
以新除御史中丞王翼為廣州刺史 「王翼」當作「王翼之」。
張森楷校勘記云：「下大明六年作王翼之，武昌王渾傳作王翼之，此脫『之』字。
」按南北朝人名後之「之」字，有時可省略。
以北中郎諮議參軍費淹為交州刺史 「北中郎」各本並作「北軍中郎」。
張森楷校勘記云：「北軍之廢久矣，當是北中郎諮議參軍，衍『軍』字。
」按張說是，今刪「軍」字。
以尚書吏部郎王琨為廣州刺史 各本並脫「郎」字，據南齊書王琨傳補。
以丹陽尹劉遵考為尚書右僕射 「右僕射」各本並作「左僕射」，據通鑑改正。
按下大明三年春正月己丑，以右僕射劉遵考為領軍將軍。
劉遵考傳，孝建三年，為尚書右僕射。
則作「右僕射」為是。
以東揚州為揚州 「為」各本並作「隸」。
按州郡志，「孝建元年，分揚州之會稽、東陽、新安、永嘉、臨海五郡為東揚州。
大明三年，罷州
(揚州)
，以其地為王畿。
而東揚州直云揚州」。
豫章王子尚傳亦云，大明二年，「以浙江東為揚州」。
「隸」字顯誤。
今據通鑑、元龜一九六改。
辛丑 各本作「辛巳」，據局本及南史改。
張熷讀史舉正云：「按上書乙未，下書丁未，不當有辛巳，作辛丑是。」
義成太守薛繼考討斬之 廿二史考異云：「案休茂傳，繼考為休茂盡力攻城，及休茂死，詐稱立義，乘驛還都，事泄伏誅。
則繼考乃黨於休茂者，紀所書誤。
南史云參軍尹玄慶起義斬之，為得其實。
」按休茂傳，言尹玄慶既斬休茂，繼考以兵脅行府州事劉恭之作啟，言繼考起義，因得封賞，尋事泄伏誅。
蓋國史誤仍當日記注，沈約竟不追改，而於休茂傳則詳述其事始末。
茲焉時矣 各本並作「茲時篤矣」，據元龜一九四改。
尚書左僕射護軍將軍劉延孫卒 「左僕射」各本並作「右僕射」，據南史改。
按前五年十月以劉延孫為尚書左僕射，見同卷。
丁卯詔上林苑內民庶丘墓欲還合葬者 各本並脫「丁卯詔」三字，據南史補。
按是月戊申朔，二十日丁卯。
壬戌 各本並作「壬寅」。
據南史、建康實錄、元龜二０七改。
按是月丙午朔，無壬寅，十七日壬戌。
普加沾賚 「沾」各本並作「洽」，據元龜一九七改。
其罪甚重辟者 「甚」通鑑作「應」，似是。
丙申 各本「丙申」上有「秋七月」。
按是年七月甲戌朔，初二日乙亥，二十三日丙申。
上已有「七月乙亥」，此「秋七月」三字衍，今刪。
可即開行倉 元龜一九五及二０五無「行」字。
東諸郡大旱 「大旱」各本並作「大獄」，據南史改。
洪頤煊諸史考異云：「大獄，當從南史作大旱。
故下文遣使開倉賑恤。」
壬寅 按是月壬申朔，無壬寅，當有誤。
遠近販鬻米粟者 各本並脫「粟」字，據南史補。
南徐州刺史新安王子鸞為撫軍將軍 各本並脫「南」字，據子鸞傳補。
若濟拯不時 「濟」各本並作「溫」，據元龜一九五改。
